title: Morrow
description: A kinder relationship with focus. A brand system to build on.

brief.audience: People who want meaningful progress without the pressure of constant productivity.
rules: Keep the leaf, round silhouette, dot eyes and short feet recognizable in every character application.
Use forest green for trust and functional structure; persimmon brings warmth and moments of encouragement.
Give the work breathing room. Use one clear message and a restrained character presence.
Examples demonstrate brand behavior. Downstream makers adapt format, interaction, accessibility and production specifications.

contexts.title: Digital product
contexts.purpose: Make focused work approachable and calm.
contexts.guidance: Use the mascot in welcome and milestone moments; keep everyday controls clear.

contexts.title: Social & editorial
contexts.guidance: One message, bold scale and a consistent character; adapt crops and typography to the channel.

contexts.title: Packaging & objects
contexts.purpose: Turn the brand into a tactile daily companion.
contexts.guidance: Explore paper, soft texture and restrained color; downstream production needs real dielines and material proofs.

items.title: The Morrow world
items.description: The visual direction: tactile warmth, a quiet palette and an encouraging companion. This board explores the system; individual asset files remain the reusable source.
items.prompt: Original Morrow identity world: persimmon plush leaf character, forest green, paper, restrained editorial typography, notebook and focus-card applications.

items.title: Wordmark & clear space
items.description: A restrained uppercase wordmark. Keep one cap-height of clear space; use forest on paper or the reverse. Final lettering should be outlined by the downstream designer.

items.title: The core companion
items.description: Transparent master asset. Preserve silhouette, leaf and expression; scale and compose it for the application without stretching.
items.prompt: Original apricot-orange plush character, dark green leaf, two dot eyes, short feet; full body, transparent background, soft studio lighting.

items.title: One identity, three contexts
items.description: Digital welcome, social message and focus-card packaging show the same identity in different situations. These are visual examples for downstream adaptation, not final app or print deliverables.
